notes_for_editor: Thin record: the FFLA gone listing, the FFLA county list (second Bennett, Lake Minnesuing, standing) and a TopoQuest map point. TopoQuest gives N46.423274 W91.878801 (WGS84/NAD83) against FFLA 46.42314 -91.87874; by our calculation the map point is about 16 m from the FFLA coordinates, so it probably marks this tower, but it is not a site check. No build date, builder, staffing or access source was found. The Forest Lookouts Wisconsin index has an undated entry 'Bennett, Douglas County - 46N-12-33' that does not say which Bennett it means, so it is not used. The Forest Lookouts subpage at bennett.html is a Missouri entry and was ignored. OpenStreetMap node 353894350 (tower:type observation, ele 400) agrees on elevation but was not quoted.
